test_item:
DebugAuth shall log an error via logdog and keep the state of all target functions when verification of AuthData from external memory failed
(AuthData verification fails; the installed AuthData is retained)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. AuthData of group X-g is already installed on the DUT
3. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
input: AuthData package whose signature does not match the manifest (invalid variant of X-g)
proc:
1. Clear the log buffer before the verification attempt
$ adb logcat -c
2. Insert USB drive containing the invalid AuthData package into HU USB port
3. Confirm DebugAuth logged the failure reason
$ adb logcat -s logdog
er:
1. `$ adb logcat -s logdog` returns an empty buffer before the attempt
2. `$ adb shell ls -l /data/vendor/dauth` shows the previously installed AuthData is still present
3. `$ adb logcat -s logdog` contains an error entry for the fail reason; the exact keyword is `PENDING: DR-SEC-h log keyword`
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-SAM-0004 Verification Criteria 3.1/3.2 (logdog assertion, R-SEC5(a) amend hit)
channel_feasible = N (trace_summary 4b) — sampled per SEC-02 §8 constraint
